column5: Headline economics AGREE - 3:2 on all three surfaces, no 6:5 anywhere - and dealing is genuinely server-authoritative on both rails. ✅ PRACTICE MODE ALREADY REMOVED (commit a28c5b3), so Casey request is done; only an orphan tests/practiceBlackjack.test.ts remains, importing the deleted module. But ONE GAME HAS THREE RULESETS. ★ Worst: points-game/index.ts:2626 FLOORS every payout, so a natural on a 1-point stake returns floor(2.5)=2 - EVEN MONEY, not 3:2 - worth up to ~2.4pp of extra house edge at stake 1, LARGER than the 3:2-vs-6:5 gap, while the rules panel and the felt art both say "Blackjack pays 3 to 2". Also: resplit aces allowed on SKAI but forbidden on POINTS; surrender is configured true, implemented on SKAI, rejected on POINTS, and the button is never rendered anywhere so it is dead on every rail; insurance exists on SKAI only; and the ADMIN rules config is decorative - neither backend reads blackjack_dealer_hits_soft17 or friends, so an operator can change what the player is TOLD without changing what is DEALT
